Commentary.Commentary: Quinton de Kock is adjudged the Man of the Match for his vital knock up front. That's all we have from this game. Do join us for the second ODI in Christchurch on 22nd February at 1100 local (2200 GMT, previous day). Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

New Zealand will not be too disappointed. They fought hard and pushed South Africa to the limit. Their backs were to the wall after the kind of start the visitors got in the chase but they hung around to make it tough for them. All the Kiwi bowlers excelled in their job. Their spinners were very economical and built the pressure which allowed Kane Williamson to attack with his fast bowlers. In the end, maybe, they didn't have enough runs on the board against a deep batting line-up of South Africa.

The 23rd over bowled by Tim Southee turned the tide completely. He removed JP Duminy and Farhaan Behardien off consecutive deliveries and brought New Zealand on top. Skipper AB de Villiers sensed the occasion and dropped his natural aggressive game. He got an able partner in Andile Phehlukwayo and together the duo stitched a match winning partnership to stretch South Africa's winning streak to 12. Phehlukwayo once again showed his mettle with the bat (played a similar kind of knock against Australia in Durban last October) and his temperament under pressure was excellent.

What a game of cricket! It went right down to the wire and South Africa held their nerves to cross the winning mark. The chase was going great guns for the Proteas as their openers laid a strong platform. Quinton de Kock was in his elements tonight and hammered a valuable knock. However, his wicket, followed by du Plessis' provided an opening for the Kiwis.

FOUR! And AB de Villiers finishes it off in style! Southee angles in a full ball around off, de Villiers clears his front leg and launches it over the bowler's head for a boundary down at long off. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 4 WICKETS!
Quicker delivery, full and angling down, Phehlukwayo fails to flick and they steal a leg bye.
Spears in a yorker just outside off, from around the wicket, Andile fails to dig it out.

SIX! Ho! Ho! Ho! What a shot under pressure! Southee lets out a back of a length ball on middle, Phehlukwayo pushes his weight on the back foot and generates tremendous power behind his jab shot. Gets it from the meat of his blade and clears long on for a biggie. 3 needed off 4 balls.

Two wides! Slower bouncer by Southee, de Villiers tries his best to hook but fails to connect. They steal another bye as the keeper misses his shy at the striker's end again. Southee collects the ball and also has a shy at his end but he too misses.
Mid on and mid off drop back.

Excellent delivery by Southee, bowls a slower delivery outside off, Phehlukwayo is deceived, swings his bat blindly and misses. AB de Villiers calls him through for a quick bye as the keeper misses his shy at the striker's end. 11 needed off 5 balls!
Tim Southee will bowl the final over. 12 runs needed off 6 balls. Seems like a nail biting finish.

Keeps it very full and outside off, de Villiers reaches out for it and forces it through covers. They complete the second run and Andile had to dive to get in safely. The throw from the deep towards the bowler's end was also way off target.
Speedy delivery on this occasion, fullish and outside off, de Villiers tries to hammer it through the line but misses. 14 needed off 7!
A low dipping yorker on off, Andile digs it out to covers and crosses for a brisk single.
SIX! What a reply from Andile! Slower delivery, full and outside off, right in the slot, Phehlukwayo gives it the full whack of his bat and muscles it over long off for a maximum.

Oohhh... Terrific delivery and Boult is really unlucky not to have a wicket. Spears in a full ball on off, it nips away a shade as Phehlukwayo swings his bat and misses. That missed the off stump by a whisker.
Boult steams in from around the wicket and hits the yorker zone outside off, de Villiers only manages to dig it out as far as the cover fielder and takes a single.
22 needed off 12 balls.
Quicker one outside off, Phehlukwayo cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Tossed up, de Villiers sweeps it past the fielder at short fine leg for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Phehlukwayo punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Floated outside off, Andile goes for a reverse sweep and connects. He gets it past the fielder at short third man for a boundary. This was very much needed.

NOT OUT! Floated on off, AB de Villiers goes for a reverse sweep but fails to make contact. The ball hits him on his pads and ricochets towards the fielder at point. The players appeal and the umpire denies it. In the meantime, the batsmen have crossed. The Kiwis seem confident as they go upstairs for a review. The replays show that there was no bat involved, the ball was in line but the impact was outside off which closes the issue. So the umpire's decision stands. A leg bye is added to the total.
The Kiwis have gone upstairs for an LBW review against AB de Villiers.
Tossed up outside off, de Villiers tries to cut it but he misses it.
Full toss on the pads, Andile fails to make the most of it as he tries to turn it on the leg side. He totally misses it and the ball goes very closely past the stumps. Lucky Phehlukwayo.
Length delivery outside off, AB de Villiers pushes it through the cover-point region for a single.
Short delivery into the body, Phehlukwayo pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, AB de Villiers clips it on the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery angling in, Andile stays deep in his crease and dabs it towards third man for a single.
Angling into the stumps, AB de Villiers shuffles and clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Trent Boult is back for a bowl. He has 2 overs left in his spell.
Tossed up outside off, de Villiers reaches the pitch of the ball and drives it through covers to keep strike. 34 runs needed off 24 balls.
Another sweep by Andile to the delivery outside off. Picks up a single towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! On the pads, Phehlukwayo goes for a sweep again and this time manages to get a bottom edge. The ball goes past the diving short third man fielder for a boundary.
Down the leg side, AB de Villiers sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
LEG BYE! Tossed up outside off, Andile goes for a sweep but misses. He gets hit on the chest and the ball goes towards short third man. They pick up a leg bye.
Floated outside off, de Villiers drives it through covers for a single.
Ish Sodhi comes back into the attack.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Phehlukwayo gets behind the line of the ball to defend it. That means de Villiers will keep strike.
Wide and floated outside off, AB slaps it down the ground towards long off for a single.
Quicker through the air, de Villiers reverse sweeps it straight towards the fielder at point. No runs taken.
Lobbed up delivery outside off, AB de Villiers thinks of a big shot but changes his mind and slices his drive towards point.
Wide outside off, Andile goes close to the line of the ball and cuts it through the point region for a single.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Slower bouncer, AB pulls it a bit late and places it through backward square leg for a run.

A tough catch goes down! Good attempt by the keeper. Southee hurls in another off spinner around off, some extra bounce, Andile tries playing late from the crease but it takes the outside edge. Latham reacts quickly to his left, puts in a dive but fails to hold on to the catch with his left hand. It deflects to third man and they cross for a single.
Lands it full and around off, angling in, Phehlukwayo goes deep inside the crease and hits it straight to point.
Another slower delivery, on a length and outside off, AB calmly guides it to third man for one.
Slower short ball outside off, Andile throws his bat at it and slams it in the air over backward point. It falls short of third man and they take a run.
Southee steams in from around the wicket and arrows in a very full ball on middle and leg, Phehlukwayo pushes it to mid on.
Powerplay 3 begins. Maximum of five players allowed outside the 30-yard circle. 50 runs needed off the last 42 balls.
The field change nearly works! Tossed up ball on off, turning back into the southpaw, Andile gets inside the crease and flicks it uppishly and just wide of Broom at short leg for a single.

An extra helmet is being brought out in the middle. Broom is standing at forward short leg. A leg slip and a short cover is in place as well. That's some attacking captaincy from Williamson. Will that be effective?
Short and outside off, spinning away, AB goes back and slaps it through point for a run.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the next man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust and this game has taken yet another twist. Santner dishes out a flighted full ball around off, spinning away a touch, Morris tries to slog it over mid-wicket but gets a thick top edge in the air. Boult settles underneath it at long off and completes the catch safely. 52 needed off 44 balls!
FOUR! Tossed up, Morris gets early in the position to reverse sweep it and nails it through point for a boundary.
Outside off, de Villiers cuts it past the point fielder for a single.
De Villiers works it down the leg side. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Mitchell Santner is brought back for a bowl.
Outside off, Morris cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
FOUR! Full in length and outside off, Morris lofts it over the mid off fielder for a safe boundary.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Bye! The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery. They have run through for a single. The umpire signals for a bye.
FOUR! A short delivery which has been pulled away to deep mid-wicket. The ball races to the boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Morris goes for a heave but he misses it completely.
On the pads, Morris clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Again an off cutter from outside off, Morris reads it this time as he defends it off the front foot.
TERRIFIC STUFF! Again an off cutter, this one came way back in. Morris prods forward in defense but he is totally beaten by the movement as it goes on to hit the thigh pad. Lucky Morris!
Slower delivery short outside off, de Villiers stays deep in his crease and slaps it past the point region for a single.
FOUR! Fuller delivery outside off, AB de Villiers shuffles a bit and flicks it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Lands it on a good length and around off, AB gets behind the line and punches it to covers.
A little short in length on middle, de Villiers helps it through square leg for one. 75 needed off 60 balls!
Full and angling down the leg side, AB flicks it through square leg and scampers back for the second run. Good aggressive running between the wickets!
Off cutter on off, it's hit down through mid on for one.
Morris has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
A touch straighter in line, it's worked on the leg side for a single.
Colin de Grandhomme comes back into the attack.
Slower delivery outside off, de Villiers stays in his crease and defends it. End of an extraordinary over, two wickets and only a run off it. A potentially game changing one by Tim!
Down the leg side, Morris clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Angling into the stumps, Morris gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Chris Morris will bat at number 7.

OUT! SOUTHEE HAS TURNED THE TIDE! Off cutter and Behardien is totally undone by it. It lands outside off on a length, Behardien prods forward in defense but the ball cuts back in and sneaks through the gap between his bat and front pad. The stumps are shattered and Behardien has to depart for a golden duck. South Africa are in a state of worry now. Can Southee take a hat-trick?
Farhaan Behardien walks out to the middle.

OUT! Another caught and bowled in this innings! Southee dishes out slower full delivery on on middle, Duminy leans forward and across to flick it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early. The leading edge pops out back to the bowler who takes a simple catch in his followthrough. Excellent start to this spell for Southee!
Tim Southee is brought back into the attack.
Slower delivery full outside off, Duminy defends it with soft hands on the off side to pick up a quick single.
Dug in short! Duminy ducks under that one.

DUMINY GETS A PEACH TO START OFF! Off cutter which is angling in from a length outside off. Duminy is totally beaten by the lack of pace. The ball sneaks through the gap between the bat and body. He is lucky that it just goes over the stumps.
JP Duminy is the next man in.

OUT! SOFT DISMISSAL! Short delivery around off, angling away, de Kock fails to middle his pull shot properly and ends up hitting it in the air towards the fielder at mid-wicket. Ross Taylor goes a bit towards his right and takes a fine catch. Quinton has to walk back to the pavilion after playing a fine knock. Can New Zealand capitalize from here?
Outside off, de Kock slashes it past the point fielder for a couple.
Angling across, de Kock tries to defend it but the ball hits the thigh pad and goes straight to the keeper. The players appeal but the umpire says no.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Outside off, de Villiers stays in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
Floated on the off stump line, de Villiers goes for a sweep but misses. The ball goes onto hit the pads and the players appeal. The umpire says no as it was always missing the stumps.
FOUR! Tossed up in middle and leg. AB smells the length and sweeps it powerfully through the mid-wicket region to get off the mark with a boundary.
Floated delivery outside off, de Villiers stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Skipper AB de Villiers walks out in the middle.

OUT! Umpire's decision stands. Floated delivery landing on middle and leg, Faf goes for a sweep shot but completely misses it. The ball hits his front pad first and then goes on to hit the back pad. The players appeal in unison and the umpire raises his finger. Du Plessis has a chat with his partner and then takes the DRS. The replays show that the pitching was in line, impact was also in line and it would have gone on to hit the top of off stump. So that means the umpire's decision will stand and Faf has to walk back to the hut.
Faf du Plessis is given out LBW. He has referred it.
Ish Sodhi comes back for a bowl.

In the air...safe! Short into the body, du Plessis goes for a pull but fails to make the desired contact. The ball balloons towards third man after getting a top edge. Three players converge, the keeper, point fielder and third man fielder but it falls right in between them. One run added to the total.

FOUR! FLASHY! Short and just outside off, du Plessis cuts hard at it but uppishly over the point region. Ish Sodhi at third man tries to stop it with an unorthodox dive but he cannot stop it. Boundary there.
Angling into the pads, du Plessis gets cramped for room and defends it to the leg side.
Short and wide outside off, de Kock guides it towards the fielder at third man region for a single.
FOUR! POWERFUL! Back of a length delivery angling into the stumps, QdK stays in his crease and slaps it down the ground through the mid on region for a boundary.
Short to start with from Boult, QdK gets on top of it and punches it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Trent Boult is back for a bowl.
Outside off, du Plessis gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Into the pads, de Kock clips it wide of mid-wicket for a single. The mid-wicket fielder throws it at the keeper's end but it was wayward and the keeper had to make full stretch dive to stop it.
Short into the stumps, du Plessis pushes it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Again short and wide outside off, Faf gets it past the point fielder but this time they manage to run a couple.
Way wide and short outside off, QdK punches it through the point region for a single.
Floated outside off and spinning away, Faf camps back and punches it through covers for a single.
Outside off, du Plessis shuffles and clips it through the mid-wicket region to keep strike.
Floated outside off, du Plessis goes for a drive but misses.
Short outside off, Quinton pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Huge shout for LBW! Tossed up on middle and leg, Quinton goes for a sweep but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The appeal is denied by the umpire.
Full outside off, du Plessis drives it towards the fielder at covers for a quick single.
Floated outside off, de Kock sweeps it uppishly towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a single.
Ish Sodhi is back into the attack.
Drinks break.

Tossed up ball outside off, Faf lofts it over extra cover. Boult comes running across to his left from long off, puts in a dive and takes the pace off the ball. He then recovers quickly to pull it back before the fence. Two runs added to the total. 111 needed off 102 balls!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Turn and bounce outside off, du Plessis flashes and misses.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Even better this time by Santner. He gets another one to spin away sharply from Faf who is beaten on the forward defensive prod.
Great delivery, drifting into the batsman and landing on off, du Plessis is squared up in defense as it spins away to beat the outside edge.

What happened there? This one probably slips out of Williamson's hand. He drops it in his own half and it reaches the batsman on a couple of bounces, it's outside off and Quinton pushes it to covers. Sometimes bad balls go unpunished.
Quicker and a touch shorter on off, de Kock goes deep inside the crease with the square cut and gets it away in the air. But it doesn't carry to short third man.
SIX! Bang! Williamson serves a freebie, a full toss on middle, de Kock latches onto it and sends it rocketing over mid-wicket for a biggie. A flat but effective hit!
Flighted ball on off, it's clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Faf du Plessis arrives at number 3.

OUT! Williamson strikes! He changes his angle to come from around the wicket and serves a flighted off spinner around off, Amla skips down the track to flick it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat too early. It pops out back to the bowler off the leading edge and Kane accepts the return catch gleefully. A handy knock by Hashim but knowing him, he will be disappointed for not converting the start. 120 needed off 112 balls.
Floated full ball around off, Amla slog sweeps it over mid-wicket and Santner in the deep makes a good stop. A couple of runs taken.
Once again a quicker one fired in around middle and leg, de Kock tries to work it around but misses and is hit high on the pads.
Flatter and a touch shorter, de Kock comes down the track and hits it towards the right side of the short fine leg fielder.
A short fine leg fielder is in place now.
10th ODI fifty for Quinton de Kock!

FOUR! A classy half century from de Kock! Flighted full ball around leg, de Kock plays a sweep shot and does so a bit late to get his placement right. He executes it towards fine leg, Sodhi runs across to his left in the deep but fails to cut it off. Fab knock by Quinton!
Tickles it off his pads to the leg side but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Spears in a fuller and quicker ball on middle, it's defended back to the bowler.
In the air... Loopy full ball around leg, de Kock top edges his attempted sweep shot and it goes aerially over square leg. The ball falls safely in the deep and they take a couple of runs.
Mitchell Santner is back into the attack.

Ooooohhhhh...that missed the leg stump by a whisker! Smart bowling by Williamson. He once again lands it down the leg side but it's closer to the leg stump line, Amla once again decides to leave it and it goes very closely past the leg pole.
Wide! Spinning down the leg side, Amla allows it through to the keeper.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
FOUR! Fine shot! Williamson loses his line and bowls a flighted full ball down the leg side, Quinton sits down on one knee and sweeps it with excellent timing through square leg for a boundary.
Flatter around off, played down from the crease to covers. Another dot ball.
Short and around off, skidding in, de Kock cuts it off his back foot to point.
Drags his length short first up and serves it outside off, Quinton goes back and punches it past the diving cover fielder for a couple of runs.
Kane Williamson brings himself into the attack.
Flatter leg spinner outside off, Amla plays from the crease and taps it down with an angled bat to point.
Attempted googly, full and around leg, de Kock sweeps it past backward square leg for a single.
Shortish and it's punched wide of mid on for one.
Plays the reverse sweep but fails to back it with enough timing. It still rolls in the gap towards backward point and they pinch a single.
Flatter and fuller on middle, clipped through backward square leg for one.
Yorker around off, Amla squeezes it out to point.

FOUR! Quinton is on fire. Southee dishes out a back of a length ball on middle, de Kock shuffles across the stumps and forces it past the right side of the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. 11 runs off the over!

FOUR! Powerful shot! A touch short in length again, around off, Quinton rocks back and spanks it past his partner at the other end for a boundary to long off. That was a boundary the moment it left his bat.
Straighter in line, clipped to square leg for one.

Top class save by the skipper! Back of a length ball on off, de Kock goes deep inside the crease and packs a punch. It races through extra cover and Williamson moves across to his right from mid off to make an excellent stop with a dive. He quickly recovers and immediately releases the ball towards the bowler's end. They pick up a single.
Goes short and bowls it wide outside off, Amla fetches it and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Starts this spell with a good length ball on off, Amla stays back footed and punches it towards the point region.
Tim Southee is back into the attack.
Loopy full ball on off, Quinton lunges and defends it to the on side.

Appeal for an lbw! Tossed up ball again, landing "outside leg" this time, de Kock once again tries to repeat the reverse sweep but fails to connect. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal but the umpire rightly turns it down.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Flighted full ball on off, de Kock goes down on one knee with the reverse sweep and nails it wide of short third man for a boundary.
Goes slower this time, around off and spinning away, Alma uses his crease and cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Quicker and fuller on middle, 87 kph, defended off the front foot to the leg side.
Flighted full ball on middle, Amla lunges and defends it back towards the bowler.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla runs it down towards third man for a single. 156 runs needed off 24 overs.
Short and wide outside off, Quinton cuts it past the point fielder for a single.
FOUR! Short and into the body, de Kock pulls it through the backward square leg region for a boundary. 50 runs up on the board.
Quinton gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Short outside off, de Kock defends it straight back to the bowler.
On the pads, Amla clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Short into the pads, Quinton gets hit on his thigh pad this time.

NOT OUT! Quinton gets a reprieve! Floated on the middle stick and spinning in, Quinton comes down the track and goes to flick it on the leg side but he misses it completely. The ball goes towards the short third man region as Quinton looks for a single but is sent back. The players appeal and the umpire has given that out. Amla and de Kock consult each other and go for a review. The replays show that the ball pitched in line, hit de Kock in line but was spinning down to miss the stumps. Good review by QdK!
Quinton de Kock is rapped on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. The South African wicketkeeper batsman wants to refer it.
Tossed up on the pads, de Kock tries to clip it on the leg side but fails to make contact. The players appeal but the umpire is unmoved. It was surely going down leg this time.
Floated outside off, Amla drives it through covers for a single.
Tossed up in middle and leg, Quinton gets his broom out of the bag and reverse sweeps it through the point region for a single.
Short outside off, Amla hangs back and pushes it towards the point region for a single.
Ish Sodhi comes in for a bowl.
Wide outside off, Amla slaps it straight to the fielder at sweeper cover to keep strike.
Outside off on a length, de Kock cuts it past the point fielder for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Quinton goes for the slash but misses.
On the pads, Amla clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Slower short delivery into the body, Hashim waits for it and improvises on the length. He plays a delayed hook through the backward square leg region for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Hashim stays in his crease and defends it towards the mid-wicket region.
Colin de Grandhomme is introduced into the attack.
Powerplay 2 time. Maximum four fielders allowed outside the ring now.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla tries to leave it but gets the bottom edge of his bat and the ball runs down towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Short into the pads, Amla shuffles a bit and flicks it past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Angling on the pads, Quinton clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Outside off on a length, Amla punches it through the extra cover region for a single.
On the pads, Amla nudges it towards square leg for a quick single.
Slower delivery on a good length. Amla is taken by surprise as he goes to defend it. The ball pops up a bit after hitting the bat but falls short of the bowler.
Amla gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Slower delivery nipping back in, de Kock cuts it towards third man for a single.
Angling into the pads, de Kock clips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off, Quinton goes for a slash but he misses. Boult is getting a good bounce from the pitch.
Short delivery into the body, de Kock pulls it towards backward square leg to keep strike.
Wide outside off, Quinton goes to fetch it but misses.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Quinton goes to flick it but misses. The umpire signals it as a wide.
FOUR! Width and punished! Wide outside off, de Kock slaps it through the cover region for a brilliant boundary. Such a good looking shot.
Slower delivery outside off, Quinton gets an inside edge as he goes to slash at it.
Drifting down the leg side, de Kock tries to use the pace of the bowler and nudge it fine but it goes on one bounce to Sodhi at short fine leg.
Short and wide outside off, Quinton cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Tim Southee replaces Santner in the attack.
Boult bowls a full length delivery outside off, tempting Amla to go for a drive but Hashim lets it straight to the keeper.

FOUR! EDGY! Good length delivery outside off and nipping in a bit. Amla tries to guide it towards third man but gets it away off the outer half of the bat to the third man fence. The fielder in the deep was a touch too square and hence fails to cut it off.
Good length delivery angling across, left alone.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL! Full and wide outside off, Amla leans into the shot and drives it through the cover-point region for another boundary.
FOUR! Fine touch! Sliding down the leg side, Amla just clips it fine down the leg side for a boundary. Easy pickings.
Fuller delivery outside off, Amla drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Floated outside off, Amla drives it through the cover region for a single.
Arm ball this time and Amla reads it well as he opens the face of the bat to guide it towards the fielder at short third man.
Short into the stumps, Amla camps back and defends it.
On the leg side, de Kock clips it just fine past the leg slip fielder for a single.
Short and just outside off, Quinton shuffles and clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Floated down the leg side, de Kock sits down and sweeps it brutally through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, angled away from the right-hander, left alone by Hashim Amla.
Outside off, de Kock cuts it past point for a single.
Length delivery outside off, de Kock punches it through covers for a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, de Kock stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Fuller delivery outside off, de Kock drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Trent Boult is operating with a couple of slip fielders.
Boult initiates his spell with a full length ball outside off, gets it to swing away after landing, Quinton presses forward and defends it to the off side.

Whoa! Another terrific delivery by Santner! He angles in a tossed up ball around off, Amla chooses to stay back in defense but it spins big away from him, squares him up completely and beats the outside edge of his bat. Unplayable. That's a scary delivery. Too much turn in the first over and Santner's spin partner Ish Sodhi will be licking his lips. Outstanding stuff by Santner!
Tossed up, Amla gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards mid off.
Wow, what a delivery! Spinning away from a length outside off, Amla goes for a drive but misses it completely. The ball spins a lot and goes straight towards the fielder at slip who fails to grab it.
Floated up in the line of the stumps, Amla gets to the line of the delivery to defend it.
Tossed up outside off, Amla lunges forward and defends it.
On the pads, de Kock clips it through the mid-wicket region to get the first run on the board.
We are back for the chase. Quinton de Kock and Hashim Amla will open with the bat for South Africa. Mitchell Santher will begin the proceedings with the ball for New Zealand.
